cards.front: What is perimeter?
cards.back: The distance all the way around the edge of a shape.
cards.say: What is perimeter? The distance all the way around the edge of a shape.

cards.front: What is area?
cards.back: The amount of flat space inside a shape, counted in squares.
cards.say: What is area? The amount of flat space inside a shape, counted in squares.

cards.front: In what units do we measure area?
cards.back: Square units, such as square centimetres (cm²).
cards.say: In what units do we measure area? Square units, such as square centimetres.

cards.front: A square has sides of 5 cm. What is its perimeter?
cards.say: A square has sides of five centimetres. What is its perimeter? Twenty centimetres. Five plus five plus five plus five equals twenty.

cards.front: A rectangle is 6 cm long and 3 cm wide. What is its perimeter?
cards.say: A rectangle is six centimetres long and three centimetres wide. What is its perimeter? Eighteen centimetres. Six plus three plus six plus three equals eighteen.

cards.front: A rectangle is 8 cm long and 2 cm wide. What is its perimeter?
cards.say: A rectangle is eight centimetres long and two centimetres wide. What is its perimeter? Twenty centimetres. Eight plus two plus eight plus two equals twenty.

cards.front: A triangle has sides of 3 cm, 4 cm and 5 cm. What is its perimeter?
cards.say: A triangle has sides of three centimetres, four centimetres and five centimetres. What is its perimeter? Twelve centimetres. Three plus four plus five equals twelve.

cards.front: A rectangle is covered by 3 rows of 4 squares. What is its area?
cards.say: A rectangle is covered by three rows of four squares. What is its area? Twelve squares. Three times four equals twelve.

cards.front: A rectangle is 5 squares long and 5 squares wide. What is its area?
cards.say: A rectangle is five squares long and five squares wide. What is its area? Twenty five squares. Five times five equals twenty five.

cards.front: A rectangle is 6 squares long and 2 squares wide. What is its area?
cards.say: A rectangle is six squares long and two squares wide. What is its area? Twelve squares. Six times two equals twelve.

cards.front: A rectangle is 7 cm long and 3 cm wide. What is its area?
cards.say: A rectangle is seven centimetres long and three centimetres wide. What is its area? Twenty one square centimetres. Seven times three equals twenty one.

cards.front: A square has a perimeter of 24 cm. How long is each side?
cards.say: A square has a perimeter of twenty four centimetres. How long is each side? Six centimetres. Twenty four divided by four equals six.

cards.front: A regular hexagon has sides of 4 cm. What is its perimeter?
cards.say: A regular hexagon has sides of four centimetres. What is its perimeter? Twenty four centimetres. Six times four equals twenty four.

cards.front: A regular pentagon has sides of 6 cm. What is its perimeter?
cards.say: A regular pentagon has sides of six centimetres. What is its perimeter? Thirty centimetres. Five times six equals thirty.

cards.front: An equilateral triangle has sides of 7 cm. What is its perimeter?
cards.say: An equilateral triangle has sides of seven centimetres. What is its perimeter? Twenty one centimetres. Three times seven equals twenty one.

cards.front: A rectangle is 12 cm long and 5 cm wide. What is its perimeter?
cards.say: A rectangle is twelve centimetres long and five centimetres wide. What is its perimeter? Thirty four centimetres. Twelve plus five plus twelve plus five equals thirty four.

cards.front: A rectangle is 10 m long and 4 m wide. What is its area?
cards.say: A rectangle is ten metres long and four metres wide. What is its area? Forty square metres. Ten times four equals forty.

cards.front: A square has an area of 36 square centimetres. How long is each side?
cards.say: A square has an area of thirty six square centimetres. How long is each side? Six centimetres. Six times six equals thirty six.

cards.front: A field has 4 equal sides, each 10 m long. How far is it all the way round?
cards.say: A field has four equal sides, each ten metres long. How far is it all the way round? Forty metres. Four times ten equals forty.

cards.front: A rectangle is 9 cm long and 1 cm wide. What is its perimeter?
cards.say: A rectangle is nine centimetres long and one centimetre wide. What is its perimeter? Twenty centimetres. Nine plus one plus nine plus one equals twenty.

cards.front: Do perimeter and area measure the same thing?
cards.back: No. Perimeter is the distance around the edge. Area is the space inside.
cards.say: Do perimeter and area measure the same thing? No. Perimeter is the distance around the edge. Area is the space inside.
